nodes.label: main()
nodes.desc: int main (L995): allocates the Scheduler, parses options, then calls transcode() at L1045

nodes.label: transcode()
nodes.desc: transcode (L901): sch_start() kicks every worker thread off, then main thread loops on sch_wait() printing progress reports

nodes.label: Scheduler
nodes.desc: sch_start (L1767) and task_start (L414): one pthread per demux/decode/filter/encode/mux task, connected by queues

nodes.label: input_thread()
nodes.desc: input_thread (L843): while(1) av_read_frame() loop (L867), routes packets through demux_send (L673)

nodes.label: av_read_frame()
nodes.desc: av_read_frame (L1646) -> read_frame_internal (L1412) -> ff_read_packet (L652) asks the container demuxer for raw packets

nodes.label: decoder_thread()
nodes.desc: decoder_thread (L909): pulls packets via sch_dec_receive (L924), runs packet_decode (L692), hands frames to sch_dec_send (L820)

nodes.label: avcodec_send_packet()
nodes.desc: avcodec_send_packet (L738) -> decode_receive_frame_internal (L669); avcodec_receive_frame lives in libavcodec/avcodec.c (L718)

nodes.label: filter_thread()
nodes.desc: filter_thread (L3507): pulls frames via sch_filter_receive (L3537), lazily builds the graph (configure_filtergraph, L2187), pushes frames in with send_frame (L3242)

nodes.label: AVFilterGraph
nodes.desc: avfilter_graph_config (L1480) negotiates formats; ff_filter_graph_run_once (L1675) advances frame processing link by link (libavfilter/avfilter.c)

nodes.label: encoder_thread()
nodes.desc: encoder_thread (L998) -> frame_encode (L867) -> encode_frame (L683) pushes frames into the codec and reads packets out

nodes.label: avcodec_send_frame()
nodes.desc: avcodec_send_frame (L567) -> encode_send_frame_internal (L485); avcodec_receive_packet (L600) returns compressed packets

nodes.label: muxer_thread()
nodes.desc: muxer_thread (L401) -> sync_queue_process (L244) -> write_packet -> av_interleaved_write_frame (libavformat/mux.c L1268); header written by avformat_write_header (L512)
